1.w: Now concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you⁺ have no need to be written to you⁺.

2.w: For you⁺ yourselves thoroughly know that the day of the Lord comes in this way, as a thief in the night.

3.w: When they may say, “Peace and security,” then suddenly destruction comes upon them, as the labor pains to her having in womb; and they shall not escape.

4.w: But you⁺, brothers, are not in darkness, that the day should overtake you⁺ like a thief.

5.w: For you⁺ are all sons of light and sons of day; we are not of night and not of darkness.

6.w: So then, we should not sleep as the rest, but we should watch and we should be sober.

7.w: For those sleeping, sleep by night; and those becoming drunk, get drunk by night.

8.w: But we, being of the day, should be sober, having put on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet—the hope of salvation,

9.w: because God did not set us for wrath, but for obtaining salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

10.w: the One having died for us, so that whether we may watch or we may sleep, we may live together with Him.

11.w: Therefore encourage one another and build up one another, just as also you⁺ are doing.

12.w: But we ask you⁺, brothers, to know those toiling among you⁺ and presiding over you⁺ in the Lord and admonishing you⁺,

13.w: and to esteem them exceedingly in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.

14.w: And we exhort you⁺, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.

15.w: See that no one shall repay to anyone evil for evil, but always pursue the good also to one another and to all.

18.w: In everything give thanks, for this [is] the will of God for you⁺ in Christ Jesus.

21.w: but test all things. Hold fast to the good.

22.w: Abstain from every form of evil.

23.w: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you⁺ completely, and may your⁺ entire spirit and soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

24.w: Faithful [is] the One calling you⁺, who also will do [it].

26.w: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

27.w: I adjure you⁺ [by] the Lord [for] the letter to be read to all the brothers.

28.w: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you⁺.
